column1: # General Arabic words that are written in English, per section 3.
# Section 3 decides whether a CONCEPT keeps its Arabic name. This table applies
# the same rule inside a compound name: the Quranic word is transliterated and
# the ordinary word beside it is translated. So المِيم الصَّغِيرَة is small_meem,
# not meem_saghirah — `saghirah` carries nothing that `small` does not, and a
# reader of either language loses by it.
# A word belongs here only when it is an ordinary Arabic word with a plain
# English equivalent. A technical term does not, however familiar it looks.
